checking: Got it. One moment while I check.
done: Every shot is in. Lovely work. Your footage is waiting in the studio.
upright: You're filming sideways. Turn the phone upright, please.
face: I lost your face for most of that. Face the camera, and let's go again.
framing-tight: A touch too tight. Bring the phone back a little.
framing-wide: A little too wide. Bring the phone closer.
room-top: I need room above your head for the words. Tilt up slightly, and again.
room-bottom: You're too low in the frame. Raise the phone a little, and again.
room-head: You're right under the app's top bar. Tilt up slightly, and again.
length: That was a little short. Hold it longer after you press record.
dark: It's too dark. Find a light or face a window, and go again.
blown: Too bright. Step out of the direct light, and go again.
backlit: The light is behind you. Turn to face it, and go again.
steady: A bit shaky. Rest the phone on something steady, and again.
sharp: That's soft. Wipe the lens, tap to focus, and go again.
loud: The sound is distorting. Move the phone away from the noise, and go again.
hello: Director online. I'll set up each shot with you and check every take the moment it lands.
hello-2: Hi. I'm your director today. Read the shot, roll when you're ready, and I'll tell you if we have it.
move: Change of scene. Take the phone to the next spot on the list.
move-2: New location. Set up at the next place, and we'll carry on.
done-2: That's a wrap. Every shot has a keeper. Head back to the studio for the edit.
idle: Whenever you're ready. Tap Film this shot to roll.
idle-2: Take your time. I'm here when you want to go again.
organized: Footage organised, in story order and trimmed. Ready for the edit.
setup-close: Close-up. Phone at eye level, about a forearm away. Let your face fill the frame.
setup-medium: Medium shot. Phone at eye level, about an arm's length away, chest up in frame.
setup-wide: Wide shot. Step back so the room is in it, and keep the phone level.
setup-detail: Detail shot. Get in close on your hands. Keep the phone still and let the action move.
hook: This one's the hook. Give it energy from the very first frame.
hook-2: Hook shot. Start the moment you hit record, no warm-up.
text-top: Leave a little space above your head. The words go up there.
text-bottom: Keep your face in the top half. The captions sit low.
lens: Look into the lens, not at yourself on the screen.
lens-2: Eyes on the camera lens. That's where your viewer is.
light: Face the light, not away from it.
steadytip: If you can, lean the phone on something solid.
checking-3: Take's in. Give me a second.
streak: Three in a row. You're on a roll.
retry: Don't chase perfect. One more go, and I'll keep the best take.
lost: I've lost the connection. Check your phone is on the same Wi-Fi as your computer.
room-air: Too much space above your head. Tilt down a touch, or come closer.
side: Slide toward the middle. The app's buttons cover the right edge.
